interpretation: The repository is now credible as an executable method/specification artifact: a reviewer can install it, create a project, preserve exact evidence bytes, compile a bounded packet, execute a governed adapter, certify packet token scope with an exact external counter, and bind release artifacts by digest. This is not yet evidence that RAKL beats strong scientific-agent baselines.
